skills.label: Quantifiers and syllogisms
skills.description: Judge what follows from all, some, none and category relationships.
skills.tip: Translate each quantifier precisely and assess each conclusion separately using only the premises.

skills.label: Conditional logic
skills.description: Distinguish necessary and sufficient conditions, exceptions and valid contrapositives.
skills.tip: Write the direction of each rule; reversing it is only valid when the question gives both directions.

skills.label: Constraint puzzles
skills.description: Combine ordering, matching, allocation and numerical restrictions.
skills.tip: Start with the fixed clues, record what each rule excludes, and test every remaining constraint.

skills.label: Interpreting information
skills.description: Assess numerical and written evidence without adding unsupported causes or predictions.
skills.tip: Check the relevant figures or wording, then separate a supported conclusion from an assumption.

skills.label: Evaluating arguments
skills.description: Compare evidence, relevance, scope and practical impact to identify the strongest argument.
skills.tip: Keep the proposal and its stated aim in view; compare relevance and strength of evidence, not personal agreement.

skills.label: Venn diagrams and sets
skills.description: Interpret inclusive and exclusive regions, set relationships and missing totals.
skills.tip: Translate AND, OR and NOT first, then include each relevant exclusive region once.

skills.label: Probability rules
skills.description: Calculate combined, independent and complementary events and count equally likely outcomes.
skills.tip: Decide whether to add, multiply or use the complement; count all arrangements that satisfy the event.

skills.label: Conditional probability
skills.description: Update the sample space for given information, dependent draws and weighted groups.
skills.tip: Define the group being selected from before choosing the denominator; update it after a draw without replacement.

skills.label: Accuracy and precision
skills.description: Distinguish correctness of measurements from consistency of repeated measurements.
skills.tip: Compare correct readings for accuracy and repeated agreement for precision; one does not imply the other.

skills.label: Expected values
skills.description: Weight outcomes by their probabilities to estimate average returns or counts.
skills.tip: Multiply each possible outcome by its probability, add the results and account for any fixed cost.
